# Repository Licensing Convention

All files in this repository are licensed under the MIT License, with Hannes Stauss
<scalarion@nimblescape.com> as the copyright holder. The root `LICENSE` file is
authoritative; the per-file header only points back to it.

## Which files get a header

Only files authored as part of this project. `npm run license:check` enforces this and
`npm run license:fix` stamps what is missing.

- Source: `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`, `.mts`, `.cts`
- Styles: `.css`, `.scss`, `.less`
- Security rules: `.rules` (`firestore.rules`, `storage.rules`)
- Config and workflows: `.yml`, `.yaml` (CI workflows, `apphosting.yaml`)
- Shell scripts: `.sh`, `.bash`, `.zsh`
- Diagrams: `.puml`, `.plantuml`
- Project-authored docs: `.github/instructions/*.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`,
  `spec/requirements.md`

## Which files must not get a header

- Everything under `public/` — these are static assets, several of them shipped by
  `create-next-app` rather than written here.
- Vendored third-party content under `.agents/skills/`, which carries its own copyright.
  Stamping it would misattribute someone else's work.
- `README.md`, `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`, and other generated or scaffolded docs.
- Binary and lockfile formats, where a header is not expressible.

## Third-party code copied into the repository

Some code is generated into this repository by a CLI rather than consumed as a dependency.
It is still someone else's work: MIT requires the original copyright and permission notice
to be kept, so replacing it with our notice alone would strip that attribution.

Files generated by the shadcn CLI therefore carry a dual notice — shadcn's copyright first,
then ours for the local modifications:

```text
SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
Copyright (c) 2023 shadcn
Copyright (c) 2026 Hannes Stauss <scalarion@nimblescape.com>

Adapted from shadcn/ui (https://ui.shadcn.com), MIT licensed.
See LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md in the repository root for details.
```

The affected paths are listed in `SHADCN_DERIVED` in
[`scripts/check-license-headers.mjs`](../../scripts/check-license-headers.mjs) and the full
upstream license text is reproduced in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`. The check enforces the
upstream line, so dropping it fails CI. When adding a component with `npx shadcn add`, add
the new file to that list.

Not everything under `src/components/ui/` is third-party: `dialog.tsx` and `tooltip.tsx`
were written for this project and carry only our copyright, as do all `*.test.tsx` files
there. Membership follows how the file was created, not which directory it lives in.

## Header format

```text
SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
Copyright (c) 2026 Hannes Stauss <scalarion@nimblescape.com>
Licensed under the MIT License. See LICENSE in the repository root for details.
```

- Use the language-appropriate comment syntax: `/* */` for source and styles, `#` for
  YAML and shell, `'` for PlantUML, `<!-- -->` for Markdown.
- The header goes at the very top, with two exceptions where it must go _below_ the first
  block: a shebang line, and YAML frontmatter. Frontmatter is only parsed when it starts
  at the first byte, so a header above it silently disables it — and Prettier then
  reformats the block as prose, corrupting the glob patterns inside `applyTo`.
- Third-party code copied into the repository uses the dual notice described above instead.
